Fetched from https://runware.ai/docs/models/<slug>/schema.json (public, unauthenticated): the video schemas and FLUX.2 [klein] 9B and Kling IMAGE 3.0 on 2026-11-10; GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst, MiniMax H3 Image and H3 Image Highspeed, Seedream 5.5, FLUX 3 Image and FLUX 3 Image Klein on 2026-11-13 (slugs and AIR ids from https://runware.ai/docs/models/index.json). Used by tests/model-specs.test.ts to check the spec database (packages/core/src/specs) against the published schemas, by tests/runware-task.test.ts, and by tests/still.test.ts and tests/image-models.test.ts for the image models.
